description: Find a company or coin from a ticker, coin code, name, ISIN or SEC CIK. Use it for "what is Rio Tinto's ticker?", "which company is RIL?" or before another tool when unsure of a symbol. A symbol two companies share lists every match with the qualified symbol to use (such as XNSE:RELIANCE). Example: query "NVDA".

query.description: A ticker (NVDA or XNAS:NVDA), coin code (BTC), CoinMarketCap ID (bitcoin), ISIN, CIK or name
